subject.title: [Feature]: Per-user heartbeat routing for channel-level heartbeat messages

question: Should OpenClaw add a channel-level WhatsApp heartbeat recipient contract for OK acknowledgments, and if so should the canonical shape be target, targets, or a more general admin-recipient policy?
rationale: This adds a new user-visible config surface that must coexist with agents.*.heartbeat.target/to, per-account channel config, allowFrom/pairing policy, and alert routing semantics.

options.title: Add OK-only recipients
options.body: Add an additive channel/WhatsApp heartbeat recipient field, validate targets against channel policy, and apply it only to HEARTBEAT_OK delivery while preserving alert routing.

options.title: Use agent-level routing only
options.body: Close the direction after documenting that admins should configure agents.*.heartbeat.target/to instead of adding another channel-level recipient surface.

options.title: Defer to broader routing policy
options.body: Keep the issue open until maintainers define a general owner/admin recipient policy that can cover heartbeat and other operator notifications consistently.

recommendation.title: Add OK-only recipients
recommendation.body: Add an additive channel/WhatsApp heartbeat recipient field, validate targets against channel policy, and apply it only to HEARTBEAT_OK delivery while preserving alert routing.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the prior review context and recent outbound/heartbeat routing history, making them the best available owner for the product-shape decision.
